target_complete_packs: 2-4; actual admitted count, no replacement sampling
data_scope: Existing authorized source pool only; no credentialed dataset access or new external data enrollment. Original full-figure panels from those4 papers permitted.

qualification_levels.training: Actual pixels and primary-source caption/text support; exact panel/question/reference bindings; legal positive, negative and unrelated relation protection; no absence inferred from unmentioned finding.
qualification_levels.development: Freeze support vs evaluation query identities before model outputs; label same-pixel paraphrase and unseen-panel tests separately. Same-source development allowed.
qualification_levels.independent_confirmation: Not required to run development; remains unadmitted unless patient/source separation established. UNKNOWN patient independence stays UNKNOWN.

role_policy: Positive/negative applicability is relative to target fact, not disease presence. Protection excludes logical consequences of target change. Original old4 exposed cases not training.
primary_contrast: INCREMENT_RATIO versus frozen V52 MATCHED_CE; V52 INCREMENT retained as historical ablation
loss_proposal: Role-normalized supervised CE for source/positive/negative/protection. INCREMENT adds hinge pair margin0.1 and negative increment hinge epsilon0; weights1 each, frozen. Exact score definition and training role schedule frozen before launch.
metrics: full free-answer paired positive/negative joint correctness
protection accuracy and Base-C damage with denominators
training fit vs same-pixel paraphrase vs unseen-panel separately
promotion: Development only: true paired repair vs CE on at least2 distinct source clusters, no new source or verified protection loss in either prompt. If fewer2clusters admitted no promotion possible but bounded feasibility can run. Independent confirmation not claimed.
admission_stop: Review only fixed4 sources; unavailable/ambiguous references remain blocked. Do not replace missing sources. Zero complete packs blocks GPU comparison, not CPU preparation.
gpu_wall: Original window deadline; independently enforced guard with earlier per-worker finite timeout
publication: Aggregate numbers/code/protocol only; private medical imagery/questions/tokens/bindings remain private
score_definition: Mean non-EOS target-answer log probability minus mean non-EOS competing-answer log probability, on each image and identical question. Competitor is the fixed true answer on the negative training image. Subtract fixed corresponding Base log-ratio.
objective: Same four-role CE plus relu(0.1-delta_ratio_positive+delta_ratio_negative)+relu(delta_ratio_negative), equal original/SHORT contexts; weights1 unchanged.
schedule: All four roles and both contexts every step, no adaptive role weights. Canonical RMS TT step with gradient norm clip1, existing proposal/construct. Same zero-writer seed and rank. No layer/seed/weight search.
split: 8 TRAIN_FIT rows; 6 SAME_PIXEL_PARAPHRASE rows; 2 UNSEEN_PANEL rows (positive and protection only), 0 unseen-negative panels, 0 independent confirmation.
mainline_purpose: Evaluate and improve the main TT editing mechanism through Base-relative positive-versus-negative increment constraints; matched CE is fixed, receives no tuning or enhancement.
hypothesis: V52 absolute target likelihood hinges were satisfied despite free-answer regression. Relative target-versus-competitor score may align constraints with answer discrimination. Training observations motivate this single change; no guarantee.
method_delta: Only score becomes target-minus-fixed-competitor. Same initialization, layer, rank, steps, examples, updates and generation.
control_policy: Reuse exact V52 Base and matched CE outputs; no CE retraining/tuning. Current score computation cost disclosed separately.
development_exposure: Same development tasks previously observed in V52; not independent confirmation, no heldout-based parameter search.
